Coffee Cake

youtube.com190 min60-75 min3 hours

A coffee cake with a twist: By incorporating a roux into the batter, we can achieve an incredibly soft, bakery-style crumb without relying on commercial ingredients.

  • For 23 x 23 cm pan

Filling

  • 75 g sugar
  • 8 g all-purpose flour
  • 6 g ground cinnamon
  • 0.25 g ground cardamom optional
  • 1 g cocoa powder optional

Roux

  • 56 g neutral oil
  • 50 g all-purpose flour

Batter

  • 250 g sugar
  • 112 g unsalted butter, room temp
  • 3 large eggs (approx. 150 g total), room temp
  • 15 g vanilla extract
  • 8 g baking powder
  • 3 g baking soda
  • 5 g fine sea salt or table salt
  • 280 g all-purpose flour
  • 300 g sour cream, room temp

Topping

  • 140 g all-purpose flour
  • 24 g cornstarch or more flour
  • 6 g ground cinnamon
  • 0.25 g ground cardamom optional
  • 3 g fine sea salt or table salt
  • 150 g sugar
  • 112 g unsalted butter
  1. Prep: Preheat oven to 163°C (middle rack). Line a 23 x 23 cm baking pan with parchment or foil.
  2. Make Filling: Whisk together all filling ingredients in a small bowl until fully combined. Set aside.
  3. Make Roux: In a microwave-safe bowl, combine 56 g oil and 50 g flour. Microwave in 30-second intervals, stirring each time, until the mixture bubbles vigorously (about 60–90 seconds total, approx. 120°C). Allow to cool.
  4. Creaming: In a large bowl, cream 250 g sugar and 112 g butter with a hand mixer on medium speed until pale and fluffy (about 3 minutes). Add eggs one at a time (approx. 150 g total), mixing thoroughly after each. Add 15 g vanilla extract and mix until smooth.
  5. Dry Ingredients: Sift 8 g baking powder, 3 g baking soda, and 5 g salt into the bowl. Mix well to evenly distribute, scraping down the bowl halfway through.
  6. Flour & Wet Ingredients: Alternate adding 280 g flour with 300 g sour cream and the cooled roux, starting and ending with flour. Mix just until combined.
  7. Assemble: Spread half the batter evenly in the prepared pan. Sprinkle filling evenly on top. Gently spread the remaining batter over the filling.
  8. Make Topping: In the same bowl (no need to wash), whisk 140 g flour, 24 g cornstarch, 6 g cinnamon, 0.25 g cardamom (if using), 3 g salt, and 150 g sugar. Rub 112 g butter into the dry ingredients with your fingers until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Sprinkle evenly over the cake.
  9. Bake: Bake for 60–75 minutes at 163°C, until golden brown and a skewer inserted in the centre comes out clean.
  10. Cool & Serve: Cool the cake in the pan for 15 minutes, then lift it out onto a wire rack. Let it cool further to your preferred serving temperature. Slice and enjoy!
